name: tests-half-sarama-protocol-response-health-ledger-and-1589
instr:
Add broker-local response health observations and admission. Preserve existing behaviour.

Metadata, Produce and SASL handshake observations expose distinct API keys. Empty responses are Healthy; topic-authorization errors in metadata/produce and SASL-authentication failure are Fatal. Mixed metadata severity ranks Fatal above Retryable above Healthy; not-leader partition errors are Retryable in metadata and produce.

Metadata observations retain distinct topics/partitions, their errors and leaders, including mixed success/failure, without altering decoded fields. TopicPartitions has one entry per decoded partition, whose Err is that partition's decoded error, including ErrNoError. Empty or broker-only metadata has no topic dimensions, and the observation-level Err of empty metadata is nil. Repeated metadata extraction returns equal observations.

New broker snapshots start Closed with no observations; reads do not advance LastSequence. Client broker snapshots retain broker identity; unknown IDs report absent. DefaultResponseHealthPolicy enables enforcement with positive history capacity and failure thresholds.

With ConsecutiveFatalLimit=1, fatal metadata opens the broker circuit; its next direct metadata call returns *ResponseHealthAdmissionError without another broker request. LeastLoadedBroker provides fallback admission and then a Probe when needed; a successful probe closes the circuit. Disabled enforcement permits metadata exchanges and retains observations. Broker-agno
